steps.name: Frame
steps.nutshell: A slow period only means something next to a normal one. Pick the slow stretch and a normal stretch from before it, and we compare the two.
findings: Incident window: 2026-10-20 10:00 UTC to 2026-10-20 11:30 UTC.
Reference window: 2026-10-20 09:00 UTC to 2026-10-20 10:00 UTC.
Calls used: 2700 in the incident window, 1800 in the reference window.

steps.name: Trust data
reasons: Only the audit was checked. A time-zone or clock-offset check needs a second source with its own clock.
steps.nutshell: Before reading any number we check that the data can be trusted: clocks agree, no call is cut off, and nothing is missing.
findings: 4500 documents read, 0 with no start time, 0 not completed, 0 with a clock anomaly.
Audit share of IIS requests: 1.00 in the reference window, 1.00 in the incident window.

steps.name: Shape
steps.nutshell: We find when things first got slower, whether it was a sudden jump, a slow climb or a repeating pattern, and how many routes moved.
findings: The change starts at 2026-10-20 10:20 UTC.
Shape: step. The P95 was near the reference until t0 and then jumped.
Scope: everything. Nearly every route with enough calls rose by the change mark.

steps.name: Time split
steps.nutshell: Each call's time is split into audit set-up, the work itself and time outside the app. The part that grew most shows where to look first.
findings: A: no share of the extra time.
C: share of the extra time 1.00.
P: no share of the extra time.
O: share of the extra time 0.00.
The part that grew most is C.

steps.name: Load
steps.nutshell: We set the number of calls arriving against how long each one takes, to see whether a pool or a limit could have filled up.
findings: Reading: calls got slower.
Planning load is 17.6 requests in flight at 40 requests per second.
Planned load is 17.6 requests in flight against a limit of 10.

steps.name: Changes
reasons: The release list is typed by you, so a release that was not entered cannot be ruled out.
steps.nutshell: We place the changes you listed next to the start of the slowdown. A change counts only if it came just before the start, not if it merely overlapped.
findings: No change listed.

steps.name: App tier
reasons: S4, S6 and S7 need data the audit does not hold (driver pool events, outbound call timings, filter timings), so they were not tested.
steps.nutshell: We check the app's own queues and pools, using what the audit and the IIS logs can show. What they cannot show is marked as not tested.
findings: Tested from the audit and IIS: S1, S2, S3, S5. Held for other sources: S4, S6, S7.

steps.name: SQL
reasons: No SQL Server data is imported for this case.
steps.nutshell: We check SQL Server against its own data: waits, blocking and plans. Until that data is imported, this step says Cannot test yet.
findings: Suspects with a reading: 0 of 15.

steps.name: Mongo
reasons: No MongoDB data is imported for this case.
steps.nutshell: We check MongoDB against its own data: slow operations, cache and disk. Until that data is imported, this step says Cannot test yet.
findings: Suspects with a reading: 0 of 8.

steps.name: Host
reasons: No host data is imported for this case.
steps.nutshell: We check the host against its own counters: CPU, memory, disk and network. Until that data is imported, this step says Cannot test yet.
findings: Suspects with a reading: 0 of 6.

steps.name: Origin
reasons: The SQL tier was not fully tested, so the origin is read from the tiers that could be dated.
The Mongo tier was not fully tested, so the origin is read from the tiers that could be dated.
The Host tier was not fully tested, so the origin is read from the tiers that could be dated.
steps.nutshell: We line up when each tier first moved. The earliest is the origin and the others followed or amplified it. If they moved together, we say there is no clear origin.
findings: Action time (C) moved first, at 2026-10-20 10:20 UTC. It was the only tier that moved; the others were read and held flat.
Hosts may differ by up to 1 s, and onsets are read by the minute, so onsets less than 61 s apart are not put in order.
Arrival rate: did not move or could not be dated.
Audit set-up (A): did not move or could not be dated.
Action time (C): Origin, first moved at 2026-10-20 10:20 UTC.
Outside time (O): did not move or could not be dated.
